rules.accepted_credit_types: Type 1 activities or courses offered by an accredited sponsor or organization sanctioned by the profession, documented by a dated certificate or letter
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt at the first biennial renewal after initial licensure in Virginia.
rules.alternatives: The Board may grant extensions (up to 1 year) or exemptions for good cause, uncompensated practice under a licensed physician, or medical examiners with 6 hours/year OCME training. AMA PRA award or specialty recertification may count if requirements equal or exceed the Board's (FAQ).
rules.audit_note: Attest at renewal; do not send documents unless requested. Keep supporting documentation for 6 years after renewal.
rules.notes: One Board licenses MD and DO with the same rule. Renewal is biennial in the birth month; the fee rule says due in each even-numbered year. 1 hr human trafficking CE was required for 2024 and 2025 renewals; no notice found for later cycles.
